nodes.name: useCollapsible.ts
nodes.summary: Generic hook for managing collapsible/expandable UI panel state, exposing open state and toggle/open/close callbacks with an optional onOpenChange notification.

nodes.name: useCollapsible
nodes.summary: Manages an open/closed boolean state for collapsible UI elements, exposing toggle, open, and close callbacks that also invoke an onOpenChange callback.

nodes.name: useCopyCheck.ts
nodes.summary: Hook wrapping a copy action with a temporary 'copied' visual feedback state that resets automatically after a fixed duration.

nodes.name: useCopyCheck
nodes.summary: Wraps an async copy function, setting a temporary copied flag to true on success that auto-resets after a fixed duration, with cleanup of pending timers on unmount.

nodes.name: useDraftNumber.ts
nodes.summary: Hook managing a draft/editable string representation of a numeric value with min/max clamping, syncing with the committed value and calling onChange/onEmpty callbacks.

nodes.name: useDraftNumber
nodes.summary: Maintains an editable text draft of a numeric input, parsing and clamping it between min/max on commit and invoking onChange or onEmpty depending on the parsed result.

nodes.name: useImmediateCursorReset.ts
nodes.summary: Small hook that immediately resets a 'was clicked' flag on the next render tick, used to prevent lingering active/cursor styling after a selectable, clickable element is clicked.

nodes.name: useImmediateCursorReset
nodes.summary: Tracks whether an element was just clicked and immediately clears the flag via a callback, used to avoid a stuck pointer/cursor state after selection.

nodes.name: useMouseMoved.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that detects whether the mouse has moved since being enabled, useful for distinguishing genuine hover/movement from stale pointer state.

nodes.name: useMouseMoved
nodes.summary: Listens for mousemove events while active and reports whether the cursor has moved, resetting when disabled.

nodes.name: useRatioResize.ts
nodes.summary: Hook implementing drag-based resizing of a split ratio (e.g. for split panes) within a container element, using pointer events and animation-frame updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Computes ratio bounds from the container's bounding rect on each drag move and clamps the result between configurable min/max ratios.

nodes.name: useRatioResize
nodes.summary: Manages drag-to-resize behavior for a ratio-based split layout, tracking pointer movement relative to a container ref and invoking onRatioChange with the clamped new ratio.

nodes.name: useRefreshSpin.ts
nodes.summary: Hook driving a refresh button's spin animation, supporting a minimum spin duration and optional persistence of the spin window across remounts via a persistence key.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a module-level Map to persist one-shot spin end times across component remounts when a persistenceKey is supplied.

nodes.name: setPersistedOneShotUntil
nodes.summary: Helper that stores or clears a persisted 'spin until' timestamp for a given key in a module-level Map, evicting the oldest entry when a size cap is exceeded.

nodes.name: useRefreshSpin
nodes.summary: Coordinates the refresh spin animation lifecycle, tracking a minimum one-shot spin duration (optionally persisted across remounts) plus ongoing spin while a loading flag is true.

nodes.name: useResizeContextMenu.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that builds and shows a native Tauri right-click context menu for a resizable panel, offering options to reset to default size, minimize, reposition, or close the panel.
nodes.languageNotes: Constructs native menu items asynchronously via Tauri's MenuItem/PredefinedMenuItem/Menu APIs and localizes labels with i18next.

nodes.name: useResizeContextMenu
nodes.summary: Returns a contextmenu event handler that builds and pops up a native Tauri menu with resize-to-default, minimize, optional reposition, and optional close actions for a resizable panel.

nodes.name: useResizeHandle.ts
nodes.summary: Hook implementing a draggable resize handle for adjustable-size panels, tracking pointer drag deltas and applying clamped size changes via animation-frame-throttled updates.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses rAF throttling plus a ref-based cleanup function for the drag listeners to keep pointer-driven resizing performant and leak-free.

nodes.name: useResizeHandle
nodes.summary: Manages mousedown/mousemove/mouseup handling for a resize handle, computing a clamped size from drag delta and invoking onSizeChange (and onResizeEnd) via rAF-throttled updates.

nodes.name: useSafeHover.ts
nodes.summary: Hooks providing hover state tracking that avoids stale listeners when the hovered DOM node changes, via a callback ref, plus a lower-level variant exposing raw onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave callbacks.

nodes.name: useSafeHover
nodes.summary: Tracks hover state on a DOM node using a callback ref that attaches/detaches mouseenter/mouseleave listeners as the underlying node changes, avoiding stale-node bugs.

nodes.name: useSafeHoverCallbacks
nodes.summary: Lightweight alternative to useSafeHover that returns hover state plus onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave handlers for direct attachment to JSX elements.

nodes.name: useScrollFade.ts
nodes.summary: Hook computing scroll-fade edge indicators (top/bottom/both/none) for a scrollable element, updating on scroll, resize, and content mutation.
nodes.languageNotes: Combines a scroll listener with ResizeObserver and MutationObserver to keep the fade state accurate as content or size changes.

nodes.name: computeFadePosition
nodes.summary: Computes which scroll-fade edges (top/bottom) should be visible for an element based on its current scroll position and overflow.

nodes.name: useScrollFade
nodes.summary: Attaches scroll/resize/mutation observers to a ref'd element and returns a CSS class name reflecting which scroll-fade edges are currently active.

nodes.name: useUndoableState.ts
nodes.summary: Hooks implementing generic undo/redo state management, including keyboard shortcut handling, a low-level undo/redo stack, a variant with external state restore callbacks, and a full undoable-state hook combining a value with undo/redo history.
nodes.languageNotes: Bounds the undo/redo stacks to a max size (shifting the oldest entry) and uses an equality check to skip pushing no-op state changes.

nodes.name: useUndoKeyboard
nodes.summary: Registers Cmd/Ctrl+Z and Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Z (or Ctrl+Y) keyboard shortcuts that invoke the provided onUndo/onRedo callbacks when enabled.

nodes.name: useUndoStack
nodes.summary: Low-level undo/redo stack hook exposing push/undo/redo/clear operations and canUndo/canRedo flags, bounding stack size and syncing derived flags.

nodes.name: useUndoStackWithRestore
nodes.summary: Wraps useUndoStack with an external restore callback and optional keyboard shortcuts, invoking restoreRef on undo/redo to apply the previous/next state.

nodes.name: useUndoableState
nodes.summary: Combines a piece of state with undo/redo history, exposing setValue/undo/redo/reset plus canUndo/canRedo, with configurable stack size, equality check, and keyboard shortcuts.
